name: lightcone-experimental
description: Opt-in, experimental skills for advanced Lightcone workflows — under active development, expect rough edges. Includes staged paper reproduction (`from-paper`), code import (`from-code`), literature substrate extraction (`paper-extraction`), and autonomous iteration (`ralph`). Requires the `lightcone` and `reproduction` plugins (install both first) because these workflows build on the core lc project workflow and the reproduction review skills, but do not bundle either plugin.
